categories.main_business_segments: First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc. operates as a single business segment focused on the ownership, management, acquisition, development, redevelopment, and sale of industrial real estate properties. The company is a fully integrated, self-administered real estate investment trust (REIT) with a portfolio of 412 in-service industrial properties totaling approximately 66.7 million square feet across 19 U.S. states. All operations are managed on a consolidated basis, with no separate reporting by geography or property type.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations center on the acquisition, development, and management of industrial real estate, including warehouses, distribution centers, and logistics facilities. Development projects emphasize best-in-class, LEED-certified buildings, with a focus on sustainability and energy efficiency. Property management is decentralized, leveraging regional teams and local property managers, while construction and redevelopment utilize industry-standard building methods and capital improvement processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: First Industrial serves a diverse tenant base of approximately 900 customers, including companies in e-commerce, third-party logistics, transportation, consumer and manufactured products, retail, food and beverage, building materials, wholesale goods, health services, and government. Its properties are strategically located in key logistics and distribution markets, catering to businesses requiring efficient access to transportation infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in the United States, with properties in 19 states and a strategic focus on 15 key logistics markets, particularly coastal regions. Major concentrations include Southern California (25.6% of net operating income), Pennsylvania (11.4%), Texas, Illinois, Florida, and other high-growth metropolitan areas such as Atlanta, Dallas/Ft. Worth, Chicago, and Houston.
categories.supply_chain_position: First Industrial operates downstream in the supply chain as a landlord and developer of industrial real estate, providing critical infrastructure for warehousing, distribution, and logistics operations. The company does not own or operate supply chain assets directly but enables supply chain participants by leasing and developing industrial properties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes maximizing shareholder returns through internal growth (rent escalations, occupancy gains, cost control), external growth (development and acquisition in key markets), and portfolio enhancement (asset recycling and focus on high-growth, supply-constrained markets). Sustainability is a core theme, with ongoing initiatives for LEED certification, energy efficiency, and tenant engagement on environmental practices. The company also invests in technology and cybersecurity to support operations and risk management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through lease income from industrial properties, with most leases structured as net or semi-net, passing through property operating expenses to tenants. Additional revenue streams include tenant recoveries, development fees, and gains on property sales. The company also earns fees and incentive income from joint venture activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: First Industrial competes with other public industrial REITs (such as Prologis and Duke Realty), private real estate funds, non-traded REITs, and developers. The company positions itself as a leading, pure-play industrial REIT with a focus on high-barrier, high-growth U.S. logistics markets, leveraging its scale, operational expertise, and disciplined capital allocation to compete effectively.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, First Industrial had total assets of $5.26 billion and annual revenues of $669.6 million, with net income of $296.0 million and funds from operations (FFO) of $350.5 million. The company reported strong occupancy (96.2%), robust leasing spreads, and an 8.4% increase in same-store cash performance. The dividend was increased by 15.6% in 2024, reflecting healthy cash flow and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: First Industrial differentiates itself through its exclusive focus on industrial real estate in top U.S. logistics markets, disciplined capital allocation, and a commitment to sustainability and operational excellence. The company emphasizes tenant satisfaction, flexible and efficient property solutions, and a proactive approach to portfolio management, including recycling capital into higher-growth assets and maintaining a strong balance sheet. Its decentralized management structure and local market expertise further enhance its ability to deliver value to tenants and shareholders.
